description: Bai toan PRODUCER-CONSUMER (Bounded Buffer) — 1 trong nhung bai toan DONG BO HOA (synchronization) kinh dien nhat, khac ban chat voi bai toan LOAI TRU LAN NHAU (mutex): o day 2 tien trinh KHONG tranh chap truc tiep 1 vung tranh chap, ma PHOI HOP qua 1 BO DEM CO GIOI HAN dung luong — Producer phai CHO neu buffer day, Consumer phai CHO neu buffer rong.
title: Producer-Consumer (bounded buffer, size=1)

Producer - riêng lẻ.description: Producer RIENG LE: 'idle' (san sang san xuat) -> 'produced' (vua tao xong 1 phan tu) -> quay lai 'idle'. Khong the hien duoc gioi han bo dem (buffer) o muc rieng le nay.

Consumer - riêng lẻ.description: Consumer RIENG LE: 'idle' (dang cho co du lieu) -> 'consumed' (vua tieu thu xong 1 phan tu) -> quay lai 'idle'.

Hệ thống kết hợp (Bounded Buffer, kích t.description: Mo hinh BOUNDED BUFFER kich thuoc=1 (chi chua duoc TOI DA 1 phan tu): 'buffer_empty' (Producer co the san xuat them, Consumer phai cho) <-> 'buffer_full' (Consumer co the tieu thu, Producer phai cho vi buffer da day). Day la mo hinh PHOI HOP (synchronization) don gian nhat giua 2 tien trinh QUA 1 TAI NGUYEN DUNG CHUNG co GIOI HAN dung luong, khac voi bai toan mutex (noi tai nguyen dung chung la 1 VUNG TRANH CHAP khong duoc dung dong thoi) — o day CA HAI tien trinh DEU can 'cho luot' chu khong tranh chap truc tiep.
